rationale: The evidence shows the principal eve.contractor@eproc.test executing unbounded reads of sensitive vendor columns (tax_id, bank_account) outside of typical active hours and from an unusual source IP address. Because analyst_ro is a shared database role for reporting, disabling or altering it would improperly disrupt other analysts. alert_summary.rule_name: Unbounded read of sensitive employee or vendor columns
